replies.author: Ogrey
replies.body:
I believe this map has quite high potential, but as previously mentioned you need to add bedrock on the bottom layer of the map. The idea of it strongly reminds me of Proelium (and also the amount of void), the only thing I would suggest is making the monuments a bit less harder to reach, and lessen the amount of void (overall). 
This is a pretty good start anyways! ^_^
